title: Quicklaunch companion beacons & collapsible doc-link panel (screenshots + asset deliverables)
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a lightweight, low-friction onboarding surface: small persistent beacons that call out important entry points (Quicklaunch, Models, Deploy) and an optional collapsible companion panel that surfaces contextual docs and one-click quickstarts. Deliverables include annotated Figma comps, exported assets (SVG/PNG) at required sizes, and 4 responsive screenshots for release notes.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: Annotated Figma comps uploaded and linked to ticket with final copy and spacing specs.
AC2: Design exports delivered (SVG icons, 2x/3x PNGs) and uploaded to Drive export zip.
AC3: Collapsible companion panel implemented to spec with keyboard navigation, visible focus states, and screenreader labels.
AC4: Four responsive screenshots (desktop, tablet, small laptop, mobile) captured and validated against pixel spec and added to the release doc.
AC5: Accessibility checklist passed (contrast, focus order, ARIA roles) and sign-off from accessibility reviewer.
implementation_notes: Use existing toast/beacon service for placement; panel should mount in onboarding context and persist across route changes. Provide CSS class hooks (.ql-beacon, .ql-panel) and a data-test-id for QA. Add telemetry events: ql_beacon_shown, ql_beacon_clicked, ql_panel_opened, ql_panel_closed, ql_dismissed.
reviews_and_feedback: 2026-03-11: PM review (Jordan Patel) - prefer higher contrast and shorter copy for beacons; suggested two-line limit.
2026-03-12: Eng review (Samir Gupta) - requested aria-expanded and deterministic IDs for A/B testing integration.
2026-03-12: Accessibility review (Lena Ortiz) - panel had potential focus trap in prototype; resolved by adding escape-to-close and focus return.
2026-03-12: UX review (Maya Singh) - recommended using compact icon set for small breakpoints to reduce layout shift.
comments: 2026-03-10: Created ticket and attached initial moodboard and copy variants.
2026-03-11: Uploaded final annotated comps to Figma and noted responsive behaviors.
2026-03-12: Exported assets and handed off zip to frontend (see PR).
2026-03-12: QA assigned to verify screenshots and accessibility checklist (QA ticket: ENG-4892).
notes: Progressive reveal approach: show unobtrusive beacon by default; open companion panel on click. Allow user to pin panel for persistent access. Consider telemetry thresholds to auto-hide beacon after 3 dismissals.
final_delivery: Expect design handoff assets and screenshot pack by 2026-03-18; follow-up QA verification by 2026-03-22.
